primary_abstraction.name: internal_mf52_peak_scale
primary_abstraction.scope: independent value at each wheel contact point as a function of x, y, and time
primary_abstraction.interpretation: relative internal MF52 peak-friction parameter scale; other tire parameters are fixed
primary_abstraction.not_interpreted_as: an absolute Coulomb or road friction coefficient

legacy_abstraction.compatibility: Existing scenario JSON without friction_mode keeps post_force; new benchmark explicitly selects internal_mu

truth_and_observation.truth: wheel-local scale is applied every physics step
truth_and_observation.estimate: capability_scale_estimate is an oracle proxy with optional multiplicative bias and delay
truth_and_observation.planner: uses current minimum estimated wheel scale held constant over the horizon; no future patch or hidden obstacle access

reference_reporting.derived_peak_rule: Separate pure-slip peak ratios at a specified load/grid cannot be demanded simultaneously. Internal scaling changes peak-slip locations and differs from output scaling.

research_use.primary: controlled capability variation, spatial patches, split grip, conditioning and model-mismatch experiments
research_use.limitation: synthetic 800 kg car; fixed remaining tire parameters; no road-specific stiffness, temperature, pressure, hysteresis identification or four-channel ABS
research_use.claim_boundary: results concern the frozen tire model's peak capability variation, not identified real-road friction
